name: get_group_detail
description: Describe a group/scene in detail: what happens when it's activated from NuCore, each controller's activation targets, link type per target (native/default/command/ignore), per-link parameters (e.g. on-level, ramp rate), and which controllers are cross-linked. DEVICE DATABASE only lists that a group/scene exists -- call this for any 'explain/describe this scene', 'what happens when I activate X', 'are these cross-linked', or link-behavior diagnostic question.

group_address.description: The group/scene's real id, exactly as shown in DEVICE DATABASE.
